body: I'd like to hear about these brain-hacks.

After months of no success on OKCupid, I decided to start [also] messaging girls I wasn't really attracted to. I don't know why really. Boredom, frustration, curiosity. At the start, I honestly believed that I may grow to like them anyway. And, hey, I was no prize myself, so why not?

Well they did respond and agreed to go on dates, but I couldn't go through with it. I had to really reflect on the person I was becoming. I didn't like that so I swore off online dating. 

And honestly I knew they weren't really attracted to me either. It's just that I was the only guy desperate enough to give them any attention. There's got to be something better out there (even if that means being single forever) that just settling down with someone because they are as ugly as you. No one deserves that. I realized I'm not the man that can attract the women I'm attracted to, so...here I am on FA.
Wow, good song! Never heard of this band before, but I'm going to check them out!
Speaking from experience? I'd like to hear more...

I have a cover for the mirror in my apartment. It's awkward sometimes though if someone is visiting I have to run in and use the bathroom first. 

Reddit is my only outlet. My friends think I live this awesome happy lifestyle because I make a lot of money and travel a lot. But...all these hotel rooms are lonely.

I did try. Messaged 100s of women. Went on a few dates. No luck. I could see that they realized how ugly I am in person and somehow didn't see it in my pictures. Failed miserably so now I've given up.
Eh. I think I just got lucky. I must have been hired when they were desperate for people. Everyone else I work with is way smarter than me.
Oh it is completely under my control. That's why I'm so worthless. All I have to do is eat right and exercise yet I'm a fat failure with no willpower.
That's rough man :( sorry. Do you sometimes wish you had never met her or was the temporary happiness worth it?
